messages:
emma-support: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting entire Console dashboards show blank tiles. They see 500s from /api/analytics/v1/query. Example tenant link: https://app.prod/console/org/tenant-77/dash and screenshot https://redwood.s3/err/tenant77.png

raj-frontend: Confirmed in Sentry. Console produced: `fetch /api/analytics/v1/query -> 500` and a couple of `TypeError: response.json is not a function` in the client. Started ~2025-05-11T04:30Z.

ingress-monitor-bot: ALERT: analytics-service 5xx spike +18% over baseline in last 10m. Active connections spike observed.

dave-oncall: Pinging @lena-analytics @mike-oncall for triage. Any recent deploys around 04:20-04:30?

deploy-bot: Deploy started: analytics-query-router (commit c7f2e9a) -> rollout 04:24 UTC. 40% updated at 04:26.

lena-analytics: Pulling logs now. Quick snippets show router returning EOF on sockets and panics in handler when upstream sessions fail. Sample:

  2025-05-11T04:26:03Z router[1] ERROR connection_pool: EOF on socket
  2025-05-11T04:26:04Z router[1] WARN query_executor: slow query 2.1s
  2025-05-11T04:26:04Z router[1] ERROR http: handler panic: invalid session state

emma-support: Repro steps support has: 1) Login as tenant-77 2) Open dashboard 3) Tile fetch to /api/analytics/v1/query -> 500 and blank panel.

raj-frontend: Reproduced with curl against prod analytics endpoint. Example output:

  curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 'https://analytics.prod.internal/api/v1/query' -d '{"query":"select 1"}'
  < HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
  < content-type: text/html
  < body: <html>500</html>

mike-oncall: I scaled analytics-query-router from 5->9 replicas and restarted the pods that were updated last. Watching metrics for a drop in 500s. Also drained a bad node.

ingress-monitor-bot: Observed connection reset by peer events concentrated on updated router pods during the 04:24-04:28 window.

lena-analytics: Correlated with cert rotation for ClickHouse client at ~04:20. The new connection-pool changes in c7f2e9a appear to reuse cached sockets after rotation; those sockets are invalid and cause panics -> 500. I can reproduce locally by rotating certs and hammering the endpoint.

lena-analytics: Dev repro script (dev only):

  # simulate cert rotation and hit endpoint repeatedly
  for i in {1..120}; do
    curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEV' 'https://analytics.local/api/v1/query' -d '{"q":"select 1"}' || echo "err $i"
  done

  # you'll see a burst of 500s right after certs are updated

dave-oncall: Mitigation options
  - Roll back analytics-query-router to previous revision (pre-c7f2e9a)
  - Short-term: force connection-pool to drop idle sockets when cert TTL changes
  - Support: post banner + notify impacted tenants with ETA ~30-60m

lena-analytics: Rolling back now. Starting rollback 04:42 UTC to pre-deploy revision. Preparing a patch to fix socket re-establishment logic.

support-ops: I'll update affected tickets and post a console banner: "Investigating blank dashboards; engineers are rolling back a recent router change. Expected recovery within 30-60 minutes."

ingress-monitor-bot: UPDATE: analytics 5xx rate returned to baseline at ~04:46 UTC after rollback completed.

emma-support: Customers reporting tiles returning. Marking the escalation as resolved for now; will reopen if anything recurs.

lena-analytics: Follow-ups: file a postmortem, add an automated test covering cert rotation + connection pool behavior, and add telemetry for handler panics. Raising PRs for both rollback fix and a hotfix for the pool.

mike-oncall: Rollback command I used: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/analytics-query-router --to-revision=<prev>`. Kept an eye on canary metrics before promoting.

emma-support: Thanks all — keeping ticket notes and will attach postmortem once ready.
